question: What claim is made about the total field-group belonging to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: There is a group belonging to all earth-moving yoginīs.
There is a group belonging to all sky-moving yoginīs.
Together these form the all-field group.
inference: The all-field group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The structure of that field-group is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: The all-field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
